note: I rated scratchpad/w16 (m01-m19) and w16q (q01, q11, q19), 930x575, built from 2e3ebfa. Between 3368ba0 and 2e3ebfa, 10_mono.js, 04_shaders.js, 12_scene.js and 13_app.js are unchanged; only 03_tex (a new sPleat layer), 07_shell, 07b_ceiling, 08_bins, 09_seats, 09a_econ and 11_exterior changed. The w15 renders are no longer in the scratchpad, so I re-measured every pixel box cited in w15a/w15b on the w16 renders. All 13 boxes reproduce the w15 values exactly: m07 curtain #3b3e46, m03 pane #2b292a, m16 pane #373534, m04 frame #c8beab std 12.5, m04 ash std 10.4, m09 frame p10 #757470, m17 lav door std 6.2, q11 bar door std 9.6, q11 counter edge #48494c, q01 wood #3f3737, m05 tumbler #313236, m04 red tab #d72a2c and m03 latch #54575c. The monuments are therefore pixel-identical in substance, and the other areas' changes (window pleats, the crest groove and econ fabric) touch nothing a monument view is scored on. I also re-compared the renders side by side with samchui_render_11, omaat_room_32 and lalf_133 (raterA16/p_bar.png, p_welcome.png and p_ash.png); the w15 judgements stand. Lighting is noted but not scored: the upper galley compartments are still washed white (m01, m09, m12, q19). Sampling uses python3 + PIL, mean / p10 / p90 by luminance over boxes (x0,y0,x1,y1); the script is scratchpad/raterA16/samp.py and the contact sheets are raterA16/sheet0-5.png. The working tree already holds a w17 monuments candidate (3ea3f24) that addresses most of the items below; it was not rated here.

issues.detail: Bar tumblers are half-rimmed, opaque cups (m05, m06, q11)
issues.problem: The single-sided rim ring is culled at the back, and the bodies are opaque near-black, so each glass reads as a dark cup rather than a clear rocks glass.
issues.evidence: m05 (205,430,300,455) #313236. samchui_render_11 (175,345,380,370) shows clear glasses with bright rims and bases.
issues.fix: In tumbler() in 10_mono.js, make the rim double-sided, give the body a grey-glass tone (about '#6a6e72', r 0.05) with a darker inner wall, and add a bright base disc.

issues.detail: Ash-wall flap frames are flat; the tabs are too bright (m04)
issues.problem: The frames are coplanar strokes of one tone, with no lit edge or inner shadow, and the corners read square. The tabs are a saturated red and sit below the top rail.
issues.evidence: m04 frame (118,250,128,500) #c8beab, std 12.5; tab #d72a2c. lalf_133 shows proud rounded frames with a lit edge, and dark glossy red clips (#66201a) straddling the top rail.
issues.fix: In buildAshWall in 10_mono.js: use a frame radius of about 0.08, make it 25 mm proud, and add a lighter outer strip and a darker inner strip. Change flapTab to about '#8e2a1c' and raise the clips to straddle the top rail.

issues.detail: Welcome cabinet head, latch and glass (m03, m16)
issues.problem: The head is about 1 cm above the monitor, so the tag overlaps the monitor line. The latch is a vertical ribbed rectangle in a square bulge. The pane has no reflection cue.
issues.evidence: m03: housing top y 97, monitor top about y 106. omaat_room_32: head well above the monitor, a horizontal oval latch in a D-shaped boss, and a diagonal reflection band (raterA16/p_welcome.png).
issues.fix: In buildWelcomeGalley in 10_mono.js: raise the head by 0.06-0.08 m; make the latch a horizontal oval (about 0.10 x 0.06) with a dark vertical thumb-turn in a D boss; add one faint diagonal pale strip over the pane.

issues.detail: Coarse ash on the bar doors and the door-2 ash wall (q11, m04)
issues.problem: The fine ashDoor layer used on the J lav doors has not been applied to barAsh or to the ash-wall panels.
issues.fix: Put barAsh and the ash-wall panel material on LAYER.ashDoor in 10_mono.js.

issues.problem: The bar counter edge is a dark slab over a grey rail. The insert frames are low contrast and the pull handles are flat slots. The q01 dark wood shows streak aliasing. The jump-seat straps read as rods. The bassinet bar remains. The pots are matte.
issues.evidence: As in previousIssues; all boxes are unchanged from w15.
